title: Team Pinnacle Membership and Feeding the Family Food Drive
description: St. Genevieve Council 14772 brought Team Pinnacle’s membership outreach together with the Feeding the Family Food Drive at St. Genevieve Parish Church. Knights, families, parishioners, and community members gathered in fellowship, welcomed prospective members, and collected food to help local families in need.
